makeMove(player, column)
    if state != IN_PROGRESS return false  # reject if game already ended
    if player != currentPlayer return false  # reject out-of-turn
    row = board.placeDisc(column, player.color)
    if row == -1 return false  # column full or invalid

    elif board.isFull(): state = DRAW
    else: currentPlayer = other(player)
    return true

'The player wants to undo' is a motivation, not a design reason; Player itself has no ability to restore state or currentPlayer.
DiscColor is just a color enum with no fields or methods that could carry undo logic.
Undo has to roll back the board, the turn, plus state and winner all together — that's Game's orchestration job, and only it can walk the whole chain back.

scenario: 给已能跑通单局的 Connect Four 加 undo：要精确还原最后一次成功落子的全部影响。
scenario_en: You're adding undo to a working single-match Connect Four and must exactly reverse the last successful move.
q: 支持 undo 通常需要哪些变化？（多选）
q_en: What changes are usually needed to support undo? (Select all that apply.)
options: Game 增加 moveHistory 栈
每次成功移动记录 player、row、col
Board 增加 clearCell(row,col)
重置或重算 state/winner
options_en: Game gains a moveHistory stack.
Every successful move records the player, row, and column.
Board gains a clearCell(row, col) method.
Reset or recompute state and winner.
why: 撤销是对最后一次成功移动的逆操作。记录 row 和 col 可直接清除对应格子，不用重新推断落点。
why_en: Undo needs a move history, a board clear operation, and lifecycle state restoration.

termDefinitions.meaning: moveHistory 是 Game 里记录历史成功移动的栈，用于支持撤销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: moveHistory is a stack Game keeps of past successful moves, used to support undo.

termDefinitions.meaning: clearCell(row, col) 是 Board 提供给 undo 用的方法，把某个格子重新置空。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clearCell(row, col) is the method Board exposes for undo, resetting one cell back to empty.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 是编排整局流程的类，管理轮次、生命周期状态和 winner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Game is the orchestrator class that manages turns, lifecycle state, and the winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: Move 是 undo 用的值对象，记录一次成功移动的 player、row、col。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Move is the value object used for undo, recording the player, row, and column of one successful move.

optionExplanations: moveHistory 栈让 Game 知道「上一步到底是谁走的、走在哪」。
记录 player/row/col 三个字段，撤销时才能精确清空那一格而不用重新推断落点。
Board 得新增一个专门清空格子的方法，因为 placeDisc 只会往里放，不会往外拿。
撤销可能把已经 WON 或 DRAW 的对局拉回 IN_PROGRESS，所以 state 和 winner 必须一起复原。
optionExplanations_en: A moveHistory stack is what lets Game know exactly who moved last and where.
Recording player/row/col per move means undo can clear that exact cell instead of re-deriving where the disc landed.
Board needs a dedicated cell-clearing method, since placeDisc only ever writes, never removes.
Undo can pull an already-WON or DRAW match back to IN_PROGRESS, so state and winner both need to be restored together.

q: 撤销最后一步的正确高层顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct high-level order for undoing the last move?
steps: 从 moveHistory 弹出最后 Move。
如果历史为空，返回 false。
调用 board.clearCell(last.row,last.col)。
currentPlayer 恢复为 last.player。
将 state/winner 恢复到可继续状态或重算。
why: 撤销应先确认有可撤销动作，再回滚棋盘和轮次。获胜后的撤销尤其需要恢复生命周期状态。
tradeoff: 先弹出历史记录确认可撤销 vs 直接回滚棋盘（可能没有历史）
why_en: Undo pops the last recorded move, clears the board cell, restores turn, and fixes game state.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: moveHistory is a stack Game keeps of past successful moves, used to support undo.

termDefinitions.meaning: clearCell(row, col) 是 Board 提供给 undo 用的方法，把某个格子重新置空。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clearCell(row, col) is the method Board exposes for undo, resetting one cell back to empty.

termDefinitions.meaning: currentPlayer 是 Game 保存的字段，标记当前该谁落子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: currentPlayer is the field Game keeps to track whose turn it is.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

scenario: 后续要添加电脑对手，但游戏规则不变。
scenario_en: You need to add a computer opponent later, but the game rules stay the same.
q: 最干净的扩展方式是什么？
q_en: What is the cleanest extension approach?
options: 新增 BotEngine 选列，照常调用 makeMove
让 Board 自动替 AI 下子
把 Player 改成庞大继承层级，人类玩家也要实现接口
复制一份 Game 给 AI
options_en: Add a BotEngine that picks a column and still calls makeMove.
Let Board automatically move for the AI.
Turn Player into a large inheritance hierarchy, forcing human players to implement an interface too.
Duplicate a whole separate Game just for the AI.
why: AI 只是选择列的决策层，规则仍由 Game 和 Board 执行。不要为了人类玩家也没有行为的场景强行接口化 Player。
tradeoff: 新增 BotEngine 决策层 vs 把 Player 做成继承层级
whenOtherWins: 如果系统要支持多种主动玩家实现并统一驱动，Player 接口或 Actor 抽象才可能有价值。
why_en: A bot can be a decision component that chooses a column while Game still enforces the rules.

termDefinitions.meaning: BotEngine 是扩展设计里新增的组件，负责替电脑玩家选一列，不改动 Game/Board 规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BotEngine is the extension component that picks a column for the computer player without changing Game or Board rules.

termDefinitions.meaning: makeMove(player, column) 是 Game 唯一会修改游戏状态的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: makeMove(player, column) is the only method on Game that mutates game state.

termDefinitions.meaning: currentPlayer 是 Game 保存的字段，标记当前该谁落子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: currentPlayer is the field Game keeps to track whose turn it is.

termDefinitions.meaning: Player 是只存身份和棋子颜色的轻量数据类，不含规则逻辑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Player is a lightweight data class holding only identity and disc color, with no rule logic.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 是编排整局流程的类，管理轮次、生命周期状态和 winner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Game is the orchestrator class that manages turns, lifecycle state, and the winner.

optionExplanations: BotEngine 只负责挑一列，规则校验和状态转移照旧走 makeMove，等于给现有流程加了个新调用方。
Board 只懂网格几何，让它替 AI 做决策会把选列策略和落子规则强行焊在一起。
人类玩家没有任何行为要实现，为了 AI 就把 Player 变成继承层级是过度设计。
复制一份 Game 意味着两套规则代码要同步维护，任何规则改动都要改两遍。
optionExplanations_en: BotEngine only picks a column; rule validation and state transitions still flow through the same makeMove call, just from a new caller.
Board only understands grid geometry — making it decide for the AI would weld move-picking strategy onto placement rules.
Human players have no behavior to implement, so turning Player into an inheritance hierarchy just for the AI is over-engineering.
Duplicating Game means two copies of the rules to keep in sync, so every rule change has to be made twice.

scenario: Connect Four 的胜负规则由固定几何决定、不存在可替换算法；有人提议引入 Strategy 接口。
scenario_en: Win detection here is fixed geometry with no swappable algorithm, yet someone proposes a Strategy interface.
q: 为什么“WinChecker interface + 四个方向实现”被视为 pattern abuse？
q_en: Why is “WinChecker interface plus four direction implementations” pattern abuse?
options: 接口在任何设计中都不该使用
需求固定，四个实现只差 dr/dc 参数
它没办法正确检测 diagonal 方向的连线
它会改变棋盘尺寸
options_en: Interfaces should never be used in any design.
The requirement is fixed; the four implementations differ only by dr/dc.
It cannot correctly detect four-in-a-row along the diagonal direction.
It would change the board size.
why: Strategy 适合真实可替换算法。这里是固定几何规则，用参数化函数更直接。
tradeoff: 参数化数据（方向向量） vs Strategy 模式换出可替换算法
why_en: The WinChecker hierarchy adds polymorphism where simple direction data is enough.

termDefinitions.meaning: WinChecker 是文中反例：为每个方向单独建一个类去检查连四，属于过度抽象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WinChecker is the article's anti-pattern example: a separate class per direction to check four-in-a-row, which is over-abstraction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 策略模式是一种设计模式，用来在运行时切换可互换的算法实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Strategy pattern is a design pattern for swapping interchangeable algorithm implementations at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方向向量 (dr,dc) 是一对整数偏移，描述沿哪个方向逐格移动，例如水平是 (0,1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector (dr, dc) is a pair of integer offsets describing which way to step through the grid, such as (0, 1) for horizontal.

optionExplanations: 这话太绝对了，接口本身没有错，错的是在不需要多态的地方硬套接口。
四个方向只是同一个计数算法换了 dr/dc 偏移，做成四个类纯属重复劳动。
WinChecker 完全可以写出检测 diagonal 的实现，问题不在于能不能检测，而在于要不要拆成四个类。
WinChecker 类层级和棋盘有多少行多少列毫无关系，它只处理胜负判断。
optionExplanations_en: Too absolute — interfaces aren't inherently wrong; the issue is forcing one where no real polymorphism is needed.
All four directions are the same counting algorithm with a different dr/dc offset, so splitting them into classes is pure duplication.
A WinChecker class could absolutely detect diagonals fine; the issue isn't detection capability, it's whether splitting into four classes is worth it.
The WinChecker hierarchy has nothing to do with how many rows or columns the board has — it only handles win detection.

scenario: 45 分钟 Connect Four OOD 面试，时间只够把单局规则做对，扩展留到最后再聊。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute Connect Four OOD interview there's only time to get one match's rules right, with extensions saved for the end.
q: 基础题明确不需要哪些功能？（多选）
q_en: Which features are explicitly out of scope for the base problem? (Select all that apply.)
options: UI 渲染
多局并发
移动历史和撤销
可配置棋盘尺寸
options_en: UI rendering.
Multiple concurrent games.
Move history and undo.
Configurable board size.
why: 这些都可以作为扩展讨论，但不应污染基础模型。基础目标是一局游戏规则正确。
why_en: UI, concurrent games, undo, history, and configurable board size are scoped out of the base problem.

termDefinitions.meaning: UI（用户界面）是渲染棋盘、展示对局给用户看的层，被排除在本设计范围外。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UI (User Interface) is the layer that renders the board for the user, and it is explicitly out of scope for this design.

optionExplanations: 渲染棋盘属于表现层，基础版只做后端规则模拟，完全不涉及画面。
多局并发要考虑隔离和调度，这些复杂度会淹没单局规则本身，先放到扩展阶段。
撤销和历史记录需要额外的状态和数据结构，基础版先把一局走对再说。
尺寸写死成 7x6，可配置尺寸留到面试官追问扩展性时再参数化。
optionExplanations_en: Rendering the board is a presentation concern; the base design only models backend rules, no visuals at all.
Concurrent games add isolation and scheduling complexity that would drown out the single-match rules, so it's deferred.
Undo and history need extra state and data structures; the base version focuses on getting one match right first.
Size is hardcoded to 7x6; configurable size is left for when the interviewer explicitly asks about extensibility.

scenario: 虽然 UI out of scope，但外部代码可能需要展示棋盘。
scenario_en: Even though UI is out of scope, external code may need to display the board.
q: Board 提供哪个只读方法最自然？
q_en: Which read-only Board method is the most natural?
options: setWinner(player)
sendPixelsToCanvas()
getCell(row,column)
makeMoveWithoutGame()
options_en: setWinner(player).
sendPixelsToCanvas().
getCell(row, column).
makeMoveWithoutGame().
why: getCell 让 UI 或测试读取棋盘状态，而不泄露 grid 可变引用。渲染本身仍不属于 Board。
tradeoff: 只读 getCell 暴露状态 vs 让 Board 直接做渲染/越权写入
whenOtherWins: 如果需要一次性渲染全部棋盘，可返回不可变 board snapshot。
why_en: getCell exposes board state for rendering or tests without making Board a UI component.

termDefinitions.meaning: getCell(row, column) 是 Board 提供的只读方法，返回该格子的棋子颜色或空。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: getCell(row, column) is Board's read-only method that returns the disc color at that cell, or empty.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: UI（用户界面）是渲染棋盘、展示对局给用户看的层，被排除在本设计范围外。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UI (User Interface) is the layer that renders the board for the user, and it is explicitly out of scope for this design.

optionExplanations: setWinner 是写操作而且改的是 winner 字段，跟「读棋盘给外部展示」完全是两回事。
把画布绘制塞进 Board 会让它直接依赖渲染库，彻底违背 Board 只管规则的边界。
getCell 只读一个格子的颜色，外部代码可以据此逐格渲染，又不会拿到内部数组的可变引用。
绕开 Game 直接落子会让轮次和状态校验全部失效，这不是渲染需要的东西。
optionExplanations_en: setWinner is a write, and it mutates the wrong field entirely — this has nothing to do with reading the board for display.
Putting canvas drawing inside Board would make it depend directly on a rendering library, breaking its whole rules-only boundary.
getCell just reads one cell's color, letting external code render cell by cell without ever getting a mutable reference to the grid.
Bypassing Game to place a disc directly would skip turn and state validation entirely — nothing to do with what rendering needs.

q: 补全 Game 构造初始状态：
q_en: Fill in Game's initial construction state:
text: Game 构造时创建空 Board，保存两个 Player，设置 {{currentPlayer=player1}}，{{state=IN_PROGRESS}}，{{winner=null}}。
why: 明确初始状态让 makeMove 逻辑简单。winner 为 null 表示尚无胜者或最终平局。
why_en: A new game starts with player one, an empty board, IN_PROGRESS state, and no winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: currentPlayer 是 Game 保存的字段，标记当前该谁落子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: currentPlayer is the field Game keeps to track whose turn it is.

scenario: 列顶端已经被占满，玩家继续选择该列。
scenario_en: The top cell of a column is already occupied, and a player chooses that column again.
q: 应该发生什么？
q_en: What should happen?
options: 覆盖棋盘顶端已经落好的棋子
自动帮玩家换成相邻的空列
直接切换到下一回合，但这枚棋子并未真正落下棋盘
placeDisc 返回 -1，状态保持不变
options_en: Overwrite the disc that's already sitting on top of the stack.
Automatically switch the player to an adjacent empty column instead.
Switch straight to the next turn, but this disc never actually lands on the board.
placeDisc returns -1 and state stays unchanged.
why: 满列是非法移动，不能改变棋盘或回合。让 Board 拒绝并让 Game 不切换玩家。
tradeoff: 满列直接拒绝、状态不变 vs 允许覆盖/自动改列
whenOtherWins: 如果 API 使用异常，可抛 ColumnFullException，但仍不能改变状态。
why_en: A full-column move should fail without changing the board or current turn.

termDefinitions.meaning: placeDisc(column, color) 是 Board 的方法，把棋子放到该列重力允许的最低空格并返回行号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: placeDisc(column, color) is Board's method that drops a disc into the lowest open cell of a column and returns the landed row.

termDefinitions.meaning: makeMove(player, column) 是 Game 唯一会修改游戏状态的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: makeMove(player, column) is the only method on Game that mutates game state.

optionExplanations: 覆盖已有棋子会凭空抹掉一次历史落子，破坏棋盘的真实记录。
自动换列悄悄替玩家做了选择，玩家实际选中的列信息就丢失了。
切换回合却没有真正落子，会让「谁走了这一步」变得对不上。
满列时 placeDisc 直接返回 -1，Game 看到失败信号就不改状态、不切换玩家。
optionExplanations_en: Overwriting the existing disc silently erases a past move, corrupting the board's true history.
Auto-switching columns quietly makes the choice for the player, losing which column they actually picked.
Switching turns without actually placing a disc leaves no record of who really made this move.
On a full column, placeDisc simply returns -1, and Game sees the failure signal and leaves state and turn untouched.

scenario: 已经 state=WON，另一个玩家继续调用 makeMove。
scenario_en: The game is already state=WON, and the other player calls makeMove.
q: 正确处理是什么？
q_en: What is the correct handling?
options: 立即返回 false，不落子
允许落子但不检查胜负
重置游戏
把 winner 改成新玩家
options_en: Return false immediately without placing a disc.
Allow the move but skip the win check.
Reset the game.
Change winner to the new player.
why: 游戏结束后任何移动都非法。先检查 state 可以避免结束后状态被破坏。
tradeoff: 结束后立即拒绝新落子 vs 允许继续修改已结束对局
whenOtherWins: 如果产品支持 rematch，应创建新 Game，而不是继续修改已结束对象。
why_en: Moves after a win or draw should be rejected before touching the board.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: makeMove(player, column) 是 Game 唯一会修改游戏状态的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: makeMove(player, column) is the only method on Game that mutates game state.

optionExplanations: state 已经是 WON，makeMove 第一步检查就该拦下来，直接返回失败，棋盘和 winner 都不动。
跳过胜负检查却仍然落子，等于在已经结束的对局上继续改棋盘，制造出没有意义的额外状态。
重置整局是另一个功能（比如 rematch），不该被一次多余的落子请求顺带触发。
winner 应该只在真正获胜的那一刻被设置一次，之后的调用不该覆盖它。
optionExplanations_en: state is already WON, so the very first check in makeMove should catch it and return failure without touching the board or winner.
Skipping the win check but still placing a disc keeps mutating a match that's already over, producing meaningless extra state.
Resetting the whole match is a different feature, like rematch, and shouldn't be triggered as a side effect of a stray move request.
winner should be set exactly once, at the moment someone actually wins — later calls shouldn't be allowed to overwrite it.

scenario: Connect Four 类设计写完后，面试官要求手工走一遍纵向连四直到游戏结束。
scenario_en: With the classes drafted, the interviewer asks you to hand-trace a vertical four-in-a-row through to game over.
q: 文章验证流程覆盖了哪些行为？（多选）
q_en: Which behaviors does the verification trace cover? (Select all that apply.)
options: 棋子落到正确行
纵向连四检测
获胜后 state 和 winner 更新
获胜后后续移动被拒绝
options_en: The disc lands in the correct row.
Vertical four-in-a-row detection.
state and winner update after a win.
Moves after a win are rejected.
why: 验证不是形式主义，它确认落子、胜负检测、状态转移和非法后续移动都连贯。
why_en: The verification trace checks placement, win detection, state transition, and rejection after game over.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: checkWin(row, column, color) 是 Board 的方法，判断以该格为起点是否形成连四。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: checkWin(row, column, color) is Board's method that checks whether a four-in-a-row forms starting from that cell.

optionExplanations: 先确认棋子真的落到了重力该到的那一格，这是最基本的正确性。
纵向连四是四个方向之一，专门验证它能确认 checkWin 不只对某个方向有效。
赢了之后 state 和 winner 有没有正确写入，是整条流程最终要交付的结果。
赢了以后再落子应该被拒绝，这条验证确认游戏真的会「停下来」。
optionExplanations_en: First confirming the disc actually lands in the row gravity dictates is the most basic correctness check.
Vertical four-in-a-row is one of four directions, and testing it specifically confirms checkWin isn't only correct in one orientation.
Whether state and winner get written correctly after a win is the actual deliverable of the whole flow.
Moves after a win should be rejected, and this check confirms the match genuinely stops instead of silently continuing.

scenario: 你要单元测试 Board.checkWin，不想构造玩家和 Game。
scenario_en: You want to unit test Board.checkWin without constructing players or a Game.
q: 哪个设计选择最有帮助？
q_en: Which design choice helps the most?
options: Game 类负责所有的扫描工作
grid 存 DiscColor 而不是 Player
Player 对象里持有一个 Board 引用
所有测试统一共用一个全局 currentPlayer
options_en: Game itself is made responsible for all the scanning work.
The grid stores DiscColor instead of Player.
Player objects hold a reference to a Board instance.
All tests share one single global currentPlayer variable.
why: 用简单颜色类型填充 grid，测试可直接设置棋盘并验证几何逻辑。Board 不依赖 Game 或 Player。
tradeoff: grid 存轻量 DiscColor 独立测试 vs 存 Player 引入额外依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果语言里 Player 是轻量值对象，存 Player 也可行，但测试依赖更多。
why_en: Storing DiscColor makes Board tests independent of Game and Player objects.

termDefinitions.meaning: DiscColor 是棋子颜色枚举，只有 RED 和 YELLOW 两个取值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DiscColor is an enum for the disc color, holding only RED or YELLOW.

termDefinitions.meaning: Player 是只存身份和棋子颜色的轻量数据类，不含规则逻辑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Player is a lightweight data class holding only identity and disc color, with no rule logic.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 是编排整局流程的类，管理轮次、生命周期状态和 winner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Game is the orchestrator class that manages turns, lifecycle state, and the winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: currentPlayer 是 Game 保存的字段，标记当前该谁落子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: currentPlayer is the field Game keeps to track whose turn it is.

optionExplanations: 把扫描逻辑挪到 Game 里，反而让测试 checkWin 时必须先搭出一个 Game 实例。
grid 只存颜色，测试时几行代码摆好颜色就能验证胜负几何，不用碰 Game 或 Player。
Player 持有 Board 会造出循环依赖，单独实例化 Player 都绕不开 Board。
全局 currentPlayer 会让不同测试之间互相污染状态，跟「独立测试」这个目标背道而驰。
optionExplanations_en: Moving the scan logic into Game would force any checkWin test to first stand up a whole Game instance.
Storing plain colors in the grid means a test can set up a board in a few lines and check win geometry without touching Game or Player.
Player holding a Board reference creates a circular dependency — you can't even instantiate Player without Board.
A global currentPlayer would let different tests bleed state into each other, which is the opposite of independent testing.

scenario: Connect Four 的四个连线方向只差一个 (dr,dc) 增量，沿线计数逻辑完全相同。
scenario_en: The four line directions differ only by a (dr, dc) step, and the counting logic along the line is identical.
q: 方向向量方案体现了哪种设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does the direction-vector approach show?
options: 每个方向都必须是独立行为
所有循环都应该消除
把变化的数据 dr/dc 和稳定的计数逻辑分开
Board 内部不应该有任何私有 helper 方法
options_en: Every direction must be an independent behavior.
All loops should be eliminated.
It separates the variable data (dr/dc) from the stable counting logic.
Board should never have any private helper methods internally.
why: 四个方向的差别只是移动增量，不是四种独立业务规则。把方向作为数据能减少重复和 bug。
tradeoff: 数据参数化(方向向量) vs 每方向单独一份行为代码
why_en: Direction vectors separate variable data from the shared counting algorithm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方向向量 (dr,dc) 是一对整数偏移，描述沿哪个方向逐格移动，例如水平是 (0,1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector (dr, dc) is a pair of integer offsets describing which way to step through the grid, such as (0, 1) for horizontal.

termDefinitions.meaning: countInDirection 是从起点沿一个方向数连续同色棋子数量的辅助函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: countInDirection is a helper that counts consecutive same-color discs starting from a cell along one direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

optionExplanations: 恰恰相反，方向向量方案说明四个方向根本不需要各自独立的行为，一份逻辑就够。
countInDirection 内部照样有循环，方案要消除的是重复代码，不是循环本身。
dr/dc 是会变的输入数据，遍历计数的算法是稳定不变的，把两者拆开就是这个方案的核心判断。
这个计数函数正是一个私有 helper，方案完全依赖它才成立。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite is true — the vector approach shows the four directions specifically don't need separate behaviors; one routine is enough.
countInDirection still has a loop inside it; what the approach eliminates is duplicated code, not loops themselves.
dr/dc is the variable input, while the counting algorithm that walks it stays fixed — separating the two is exactly the judgment this approach makes.
That counting helper is itself a private routine, and the whole approach depends on it existing.

q: 按顺序排列 Connect Four 的主设计链路：
q_en: Put the main Connect Four design chain in order:
steps: 用 GameState enum 表示生命周期，避免多个 boolean。
Board 使用 grid<DiscColor?>，封装落子和 win check。
先澄清固定 7x6、单局、无 UI/undo。
Game 作为入口，验证轮次并调用 Board。
checkWin 用四个方向向量而非四个类。
why: 这条链路从范围、状态建模、职责边界到核心算法。按此表达能展示设计不是随意拆类。
tradeoff: 先定范围/状态建模，再定编排和算法 vs 没有分层直接写代码
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to state modeling, orchestration, board responsibility, and vector-based win checking.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 是编排整局流程的类，管理轮次、生命周期状态和 winner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Game is the orchestrator class that manages turns, lifecycle state, and the winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方向向量 (dr,dc) 是一对整数偏移，描述沿哪个方向逐格移动，例如水平是 (0,1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector (dr, dc) is a pair of integer offsets describing which way to step through the grid, such as (0, 1) for horizontal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 枚举（enum）是只能取一组预先定义常量之一的类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum is a type that can only hold one of a fixed set of predefined constant values.

scenario: Connect Four OOD 面试收尾，面试官在数 senior 信号：你主动解释了哪些职责边界。
scenario_en: As the Connect Four OOD round wraps up, the interviewer is counting senior signals: which boundaries did you explain unprompted?
q: Senior 级答案应主动说明哪些设计点？（多选）
q_en: Which design points should a senior-level answer call out? (Select all that apply.)
options: Player 是数据对象而非规则引擎
GameState enum 优于多个 boolean
win checking 属于 Board
方向向量优于过度 WinChecker 类层级
options_en: Player is a data object, not a rules engine.
A GameState enum beats multiple booleans.
Win checking belongs to Board.
Direction vectors beat an over-engineered WinChecker class hierarchy.
why: 高级答案不仅能写代码，还能解释为什么这些边界稳定。尤其要能识别何时不使用模式。
why_en: Senior answers justify simple boundaries and avoid unnecessary design patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: Player 是只存身份和棋子颜色的轻量数据类，不含规则逻辑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Player is a lightweight data class holding only identity and disc color, with no rule logic.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: Board 是拥有 7x6 网格状态、负责落子和胜负几何检查的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Board is the class that owns the 7x6 grid state and handles disc placement and win-geometry checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: WinChecker 是文中反例：为每个方向单独建一个类去检查连四，属于过度抽象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WinChecker is the article's anti-pattern example: a separate class per direction to check four-in-a-row, which is over-abstraction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方向向量 (dr,dc) 是一对整数偏移，描述沿哪个方向逐格移动，例如水平是 (0,1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector (dr, dc) is a pair of integer offsets describing which way to step through the grid, such as (0, 1) for horizontal.

optionExplanations: 点明 Player 只是数据对象，说明候选人分得清身份数据和规则引擎的边界。
解释 enum 优于多个 boolean，说明候选人在意非法状态能不能被类型系统排除。
指出胜负检查归 Board，说明候选人清楚谁最懂网格就该谁负责几何判断。
能说出方向向量优于四个 WinChecker 类，说明候选人懂得识别何时不该用设计模式。
optionExplanations_en: Calling out that Player is just a data object shows the candidate separates identity data from a rules engine.
Explaining why an enum beats multiple booleans shows the candidate cares whether illegal states are excluded by the type system.
Pointing out that win checking belongs on Board shows understanding that whoever owns the grid should own the geometry.
Being able to say direction vectors beat four WinChecker classes shows the candidate recognizes when NOT to reach for a pattern.

scenario: 你要总结 makeMove 的关键不变量。
scenario_en: You need to summarize the key invariant of makeMove.
q: 哪个不变量最准确？
q_en: Which invariant is most accurate?
options: 任何玩家都能在任何状态落子
Board 负责切换玩家
每次移动都必须产生 winner
成功移动只改一格，且只能当前玩家执行
options_en: Any player can move in any state.
Board is responsible for switching players.
Every move must produce a winner.
A successful move changes one cell and only the current player can make it.
why: 成功移动是唯一改变棋盘的路径，且受 state 和 turn 保护。这个不变量让游戏流程可推理。
tradeoff: 不变量保护单格变更+仅当前玩家 vs 不加约束允许任意状态落子
whenOtherWins: 如果加入并发网络对战，还需要同步 makeMove 以保护同一局状态。
why_en: A successful move changes one cell and is only allowed for the current player while the game is in progress.

termDefinitions.meaning: currentPlayer 是 Game 保存的字段，标记当前该谁落子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: currentPlayer is the field Game keeps to track whose turn it is.

termDefinitions.meaning: GameState 是表示对局生命周期的枚举，只能是 IN_PROGRESS、WON 或 DRAW 之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameState is an enum that represents the match lifecycle as exactly one of IN_PROGRESS, WON, or DRAW.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不变量（invariant）是系统在任何合法操作后都必须保持成立的规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a rule that must remain true after every legal operation on the system.

optionExplanations: 这恰好是要被拒绝的情况：state 和轮次校验存在就是为了不让任何人任何时候都能落子。
切换玩家是 Game 的职责，Board 从头到尾不知道谁是当前玩家。
大多数移动只是普通落子，并不会产生 winner，平局和继续对局都是合法结果。
每次成功落子只写入一个格子，并且只有轮到的玩家才能触发，这条约束贯穿整个 makeMove。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly what should be rejected — the state and turn checks exist specifically so not just anyone can move at any time.
Switching players is Game's job; Board never knows who the current player is at all.
Most moves are ordinary placements that produce no winner — continuing play or a draw are both valid outcomes.
Every successful move writes exactly one cell, and only the player whose turn it is can trigger it — that constraint holds throughout makeMove.

scenario: 两位候选人的 Connect Four 都能正确判定胜负，差别只在 win-checking 怎么写。
scenario_en: Two candidates both detect wins correctly in Connect Four; the only difference is how win checking is written.
q: 中级和高级答案在 win-checking 上的分水岭是什么？
q_en: What separates mid-level and senior answers on win checking?
options: 方向向量配合 countInDirection
只实现横向检查
把胜负判定逻辑全塞进一个巨大的 Game 类
让 UI 判断胜负
options_en: Cover all four directions with direction vectors and countInDirection, and explain why not to split into four classes.
Only implement horizontal checking.
Cram all the win-checking logic into one giant Game class.
Let the UI decide who won.
why: 方向向量方案体现模式识别和克制抽象。它比四份重复代码或类层级都更适合固定规则游戏。
tradeoff: 方向向量+countInDirection 通用算法 vs 只做部分方向或塞进 Game/UI
why_en: The vector-based countInDirection approach is the clean expected solution for all four win directions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方向向量 (dr,dc) 是一对整数偏移，描述沿哪个方向逐格移动，例如水平是 (0,1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector (dr, dc) is a pair of integer offsets describing which way to step through the grid, such as (0, 1) for horizontal.

termDefinitions.meaning: countInDirection 是从起点沿一个方向数连续同色棋子数量的辅助函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: countInDirection is a helper that counts consecutive same-color discs starting from a cell along one direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 是编排整局流程的类，管理轮次、生命周期状态和 winner。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Game is the orchestrator class that manages turns, lifecycle state, and the winner.

termDefinitions.meaning: UI（用户界面）是渲染棋盘、展示对局给用户看的层，被排除在本设计范围外。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UI (User Interface) is the layer that renders the board for the user, and it is explicitly out of scope for this design.

optionExplanations: 覆盖全部四个方向、复用同一份 countInDirection，还能讲清楚为什么不拆四个类，这才是完整答案。
只做横向检查会直接漏掉纵向和两条对角线的胜利，是明显的功能缺失。
把胜负几何塞进 Game，会让 Game 同时懂编排又懂网格坐标，职责边界就消失了。
UI 本就不在设计范围内，让它判断胜负等于把规则逻辑泄漏到表现层。
optionExplanations_en: Covering all four directions with one shared countInDirection, and being able to explain why it's not split into four classes, is the complete answer.
Only implementing horizontal checking flat-out misses vertical and both diagonal wins — a clear functional gap.
Cramming win geometry into Game would make it understand both orchestration and grid coordinates at once, erasing the responsibility boundary.
UI is out of scope by design; letting it decide the winner would leak rules logic into the presentation layer.

scenario: Connect Four 固定 7x6 棋盘，placeDisc 每次落子都从底部逐格扫描找空位。
scenario_en: The board is a fixed 7x6 grid, and placeDisc scans from the bottom row each time it is called.
q: 该不该给 placeDisc 加 heights[cols] 缓存？
q_en: Should placeDisc cache a heights[cols] array?
options: 不用：7x6 最多扫 6 格，线性扫描已经够快
必须加，否则 placeDisc 会算错落子的行号
heights[cols] 该放在 Game 里，不该放在 Board
线性扫描是 O(rows·cols)，必须立刻优化掉
options_en: No — on a 7x6 board the scan is at most six cells, already fast enough.
Yes, otherwise placeDisc would compute the wrong landing row.
heights[cols] belongs on Game, not on Board.
The scan is O(rows·cols), so it must be optimized right away.
why: 7x6 棋盘线性扫描最多 6 步可以忽略；heights[cols] 只有棋盘更大或被高频调用时才值得维护。
why_en: On a 7x6 board the scan is at most six steps and negligible; heights[cols] only pays off on a bigger board or under heavy call volume.
tradeoff: 简单线性扫描（可读、零额外状态）vs 维护 heights[cols] 缓存（O(1) 查询、多一份要同步的状态）
whenOtherWins: 棋盘远大于 7x6，或 placeDisc 被高频调用（比如搜索引擎里每秒成千上万次），heights[cols] 的 O(1) 查询才值得多维护一份状态。

termDefinitions.meaning: heights[cols] 是缓存每一列下一个可落子空行位置的数组，用来把 placeDisc 的查找从线性扫描降到 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: heights[cols] is an array caching the next open row per column, turning placeDisc's lookup from a linear scan into O(1).

optionExplanations: 6 格线性扫描几乎零成本，加缓存的复杂度收益不成比例。
扫描本身没错：从底部找到第一个空格就是正确落点，行号不会错。
两个类都能维护它，但它是网格局部状态，天然属于 Board 而不是 Game。
复杂度记号吓人，但 7x6 的 rows·cols=42 远小到可以忽略。
optionExplanations_en: A six-cell scan is basically free, so caching adds complexity for no real payoff.
The scan itself is correct — the first empty cell from the bottom is the right landing row.
Either class could hold it, but it's grid-local state, so it naturally belongs on Board, not Game.
The big-O notation sounds scary, but rows·cols = 42 on a 7x6 board is small enough to ignore.

scenario: 面试官问：这套 Connect Four 设计是纯后端规则引擎，还是要支持前端画棋盘？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether this Connect Four design is backend-only or must also support a rendering UI.
q: 这个范围澄清如何决定 Board 的公开方法？
q_en: How does that scope answer decide Board's public API?
options: 纯后端保持规则方法最小化，要支持 UI 才加批量读取方法
不管有没有 UI，都该先加上 getBoardState 和 getValidMoves 备用
只要提到 UI，就该把内部 grid 数组直接设为 public 字段
UI 支持与否只影响 Player 类怎么命名，不影响 Board 方法
options_en: Backend-only keeps rule methods minimal; only add bulk-read methods once UI support is needed.
Add getBoardState and getValidMoves up front regardless of whether UI is in scope.
Once UI is mentioned, expose the internal grid array as a public field.
UI support only affects how the Player class is named, not Board's methods.
why: 范围决定 API 表面：纯后端保持最小规则接口；要支持渲染才加批量读取方法，不用提前加也不用改成 public 字段。
why_en: Scope decides the API surface: backend-only keeps a minimal rules interface, and only adding UI support calls for bulk-read methods.
tradeoff: 极简规则 API（backend-only）vs 加批量读取方法（getBoardState/getValidMoves，支持渲染）
whenOtherWins: 如果需求早期就明确要支持网页或 App 渲染，提前设计 getBoardState/getValidMoves 反而省一次返工。

termDefinitions.meaning: getBoardState() 是返回整张棋盘快照的批量读取方法，供渲染层一次性拿到全部格子状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: getBoardState() is a bulk read method that returns a full snapshot of the board for a rendering layer.

termDefinitions.meaning: getValidMoves() 是返回当前所有合法落子列的方法，供 UI 提前禁用已满的列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: getValidMoves() returns the columns that can currently accept a disc, so a UI can disable full columns.

optionExplanations: 范围决定 API 大小：只做后端规则就不需要批量渲染接口，加了才要加。
提前加这些方法违反了按已知范围设计，需求没定就先扩大了 API 面。
暴露可变的 grid 引用等于放弃封装，外部代码能绕过 placeDisc 直接改状态。
Player 命名和 Board 方法数量是两件事，UI 范围根本不会影响 Player。
optionExplanations_en: Scope sets API size: backend-only doesn't need bulk render methods until UI is actually required.
Adding these up front violates designing to the known scope — the API grows before the requirement exists.
Exposing the mutable grid breaks encapsulation — outside code could mutate it without going through placeDisc.
Player's naming and Board's method count are unrelated; UI scope never touches Player.

scenario: 面试官追问加电脑对手；候选人提出把 Player 改成接口，衍生 HumanPlayer 和 BotPlayer。
scenario_en: Asked to add a computer opponent, a candidate proposes turning Player into an interface with HumanPlayer and BotPlayer.
q: 为什么这个方案不如单独加 BotEngine？
q_en: Why is that weaker than adding a separate BotEngine instead?
options: 人类玩家本来就没有行为，把 Player 接口化是加抽象却没换来价值
接口在大多数语言里根本无法实现，语法不支持
HumanPlayer 和 BotPlayer 必须共享同一个 Board 实例，接口做不到
这样做会让 makeMove 的签名从两个参数变成三个参数
options_en: A human player doesn't do anything, so making Player an interface adds abstraction without value.
Interfaces are basically unsupported syntax in most mainstream languages.
HumanPlayer and BotPlayer would be forced to share one Board instance, which an interface can't do.
It would change makeMove's signature from two arguments to three.
why: 人类玩家只是数据，不需要方法；BotEngine 把选列逻辑放在薄薄一层决策组件里，Game 和 Board 完全不变。
why_en: A human player is just data with no behavior; BotEngine keeps the column-picking logic in a thin decision layer while Game and Board stay untouched.
tradeoff: BotEngine 决策层（Player 保持纯数据）vs Player 接口化（HumanPlayer/BotPlayer 实现类）
whenOtherWins: 如果未来每种玩家真的需要不同行为（比如观战权限、道具效果），把 Player 变成带行为的接口才开始有价值。

termDefinitions.meaning: BotEngine 是一个只负责挑选列号的薄决策层类，通过 chooseMove(game) 返回一个合法列，不改变 Game 或 Board 的规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BotEngine is a thin decision-making class that only picks a column via chooseMove(game); it never changes Game or Board's rules.

optionExplanations: 人类玩家不做任何事，只是数据；接口化是为不存在的行为多绕一层。
接口语法在几乎所有主流语言里都支持，问题不在语法能不能实现。
两种玩家类型完全可以各自持有或不持有 Board 引用，不是接口化的障碍。
参数个数与 Player 是不是接口无关，makeMove 签名不会因此改变。
optionExplanations_en: A human player doesn't 'do' anything; making Player an interface adds a layer for behavior that doesn't exist.
Interfaces are supported by essentially every mainstream language; syntax isn't the actual blocker.
Both player kinds can hold or not hold a Board reference independently; that's not what an interface blocks.
Argument count is unrelated to whether Player is an interface — makeMove's signature doesn't change.

scenario: Game 只有 makeMove 会修改内部状态，getCurrentPlayer/getGameState/getWinner/getBoard 都是只读查询。
scenario_en: Only makeMove mutates Game's internal state; getCurrentPlayer, getGameState, getWinner, and getBoard are all read-only.
q: 这种读写分离带来什么好处？
q_en: What benefit does this read/write split give you?
options: 调用只读方法查看进度不会产生副作用，可以随时安全调用
这样可以完全省略掉 winner 字段，改用计算属性代替
这让 Board 也不需要再校验列边界，交给这些只读方法处理
这意味着 UI 层可以绕过 makeMove，直接改 currentPlayer
options_en: Calling a read-only method to check progress has no side effects, so it's always safe to call.
It lets you drop the winner field entirely and use a computed property instead.
It means Board no longer needs to validate column bounds — these read methods handle it.
It means the UI layer can bypass makeMove and change currentPlayer directly.
why: 读写分离让调用方可以随时安全地查询状态，不用担心一次 get 调用意外改变了游戏结果。
why_en: Separating reads from the one write lets callers query state anytime without worrying that a getter accidentally changes the outcome.
optionExplanations: 只读方法没有副作用，随时调用都不会打乱游戏状态，这正是读写分离的价值。
winner 是否用字段还是计算属性是实现细节，跟只读方法数量无关。
列边界校验属于 Board.placeDisc 的职责，跟 Game 的只读方法完全无关。
恰恰相反：只读方法不暴露修改能力，UI 仍然只能通过 makeMove 改状态。
optionExplanations_en: Read-only methods have no side effects, so calling them anytime never disturbs game state — that's the value of read/write separation.
Whether winner is a stored field or a computed property is an implementation detail, unrelated to how many methods are read-only.
Column-bounds validation is placeDisc's job on Board, unrelated to Game's read-only methods.
The opposite is true — read-only methods expose no mutation power; the UI can still only change state via makeMove.

scenario: Game 用 GameState enum 加一个可空的 winner: Player? 字段表示结果。
scenario_en: Game represents the outcome with a GameState enum plus a nullable winner: Player? field.
q: winner 用 nullable 而不是特殊哨兵值，好在哪？
q_en: Why is a nullable winner better than a special sentinel value?
options: null 清楚表示没有获胜者，不用借用某个假 Player 当占位符
nullable 字段在大多数语言里比字符串字段占用更少内存
只有 nullable 类型才能被 GameState enum 引用
这样可以把 DRAW 从 GameState 里去掉，靠 winner==null 判断
options_en: null clearly means there's no winner, instead of borrowing a fake Player as a placeholder.
Nullable fields use less memory than string fields in most languages.
Only a nullable type can be referenced by the GameState enum.
It lets you remove DRAW from GameState and infer it from winner==null instead.
why: 平局时本来就没有赢家，null 直接表达无值；借用一个假 Player 当占位符反而制造额外的特殊状态要记。
why_en: In a draw there simply is no winner, so null expresses 'no value' directly, instead of overloading a fake sentinel Player to mean none.
tradeoff: nullable winner（无值即 null）vs 特殊哨兵 Player（借用一个假值当占位符）
whenOtherWins: 如果目标语言没有安全的可空类型、调用方容易忘记判空，用不可变的哨兵对象有时能省掉运行时空值检查。
optionExplanations: null 就是没有，不需要为不存在的赢家硬造一个假 Player 对象来表示它。
内存占用不是这里的考虑点，取舍强调的是语义清晰，不是空间优化。
GameState enum 和 winner 字段是否可空是两个独立的类型决定，互不依赖。
DRAW 仍然是一个真实进行中的生命周期状态，不能靠 winner 是否为空来间接推断。
optionExplanations_en: null just means 'none' — there's no need to fabricate a fake Player to represent a winner that doesn't exist.
Memory footprint isn't the point here; the reasoning is about semantic clarity, not space.
Whether GameState is an enum and whether winner is nullable are two independent type decisions.
DRAW is still a real, ongoing outcome state; you can't infer it indirectly from whether winner happens to be null.

scenario: 有候选人提议：Game 先调用 board.canPlace(column)，为 true 才调用 board.placeDisc(column,color)。
scenario_en: A candidate proposes Game call board.canPlace(column) first, and only call placeDisc if that returns true.
q: 为什么文章不建议这种两步校验？
q_en: Why doesn't the article recommend this two-step check?
options: 校验逻辑被拆成两处，且两次调用之间棋盘状态可能已经变化
canPlace 方法本身设计错误，返回值永远是 false
这样会让 Board 不再需要 rows 和 cols 字段
两步调用会让 checkWin 无法获得正确的 row 参数
options_en: The check splits across two places, and board state could change between the two calls.
canPlace itself is broken and always returns false.
It would mean Board no longer needs its rows and cols fields.
The two-step call would stop checkWin from getting the correct row argument.
why: canPlace 判断和 placeDisc 判断之间存在时间差，状态可能已变；让 placeDisc 内部统一校验并返回 -1，逻辑只写一处更不容易出错。
why_en: There's a gap between the canPlace check and the placeDisc call during which state could change; keeping all validation inside placeDisc means the logic lives in exactly one place.
tradeoff: placeDisc 内部统一校验（一处逻辑，返回 -1 表示拒绝）vs Game 先 canPlace 再 placeDisc（两处校验，之间有间隙）
whenOtherWins: 如果 canPlace 结果要单独展示给 UI（比如提前置灰已满的列），暴露它做只读查询是合理的，但落子那一刻仍要让 placeDisc 自己再校验一次。
optionExplanations: 先查后做之间棋盘可能被其他调用改变，而且校验逻辑分散在两个方法里，容易只改一处漏改另一处。
canPlace 本身实现没问题，问题在于把它单独作为落子前置步骤来用。
rows/cols 字段是 Board 判断边界必需的状态，跟校验放几步无关。
checkWin 需要的 row 来自 placeDisc 的返回值，两步调用本身不影响这一点。
optionExplanations_en: Board state can change in the gap between the two calls, and splitting the check across two methods means a future fix can update one and miss the other.
canPlace's own implementation is fine; the issue is only using it as a separate pre-check before placement.
rows/cols are state Board needs regardless of how many validation steps happen.
The row checkWin needs comes from placeDisc's return value either way; the two-step call doesn't change that.

scenario: 游戏已经 state=WON、winner=player1；玩家请求撤销最后一步。
scenario_en: The game is already state=WON with winner=player1, and a player requests to undo the last move.
q: 撤销这一步后，Game 的 state 该怎么处理？
q_en: After undoing that move, what should Game's state become?
options: 变回 IN_PROGRESS，winner 清空
保持 WON 不变，只清掉棋盘上那颗致胜棋子
改成 DRAW，因为已经没有明确的赢家了
抛出异常，已结束的游戏不允许再撤销
options_en: Back to IN_PROGRESS, winner cleared.
Leave it at WON and only clear that disc on the board.
Change it to DRAW, since there's no longer a clear winner.
Throw an exception — an already-finished game can't be undone.
why: 撤销先弹出 moveHistory 顶部记录、清空该格，再把 state 重置为 IN_PROGRESS、winner 置空；简化版直接重置，不重新扫描全盘。
why_en: Undo pops the last move off moveHistory, clears that cell, then resets state to IN_PROGRESS and winner to null — the simple version resets outright instead of rescanning the whole board.
tradeoff: 撤销后直接重置 state（简单、面试够用）vs 撤销后重新扫描棋盘计算 state（生产级更严谨、更贵）
whenOtherWins: 生产环境如果要支持撤销任意历史步骤，不只是最后一步，就必须重新扫描棋盘算 state，不能假设直接回到 IN_PROGRESS。

termDefinitions.meaning: moveHistory 是 Game 里的一个栈，记录每次成功落子的 player、row、col，用来支持撤销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: moveHistory is a stack on Game that records the player, row, and column of every successful move, to support undo.

optionExplanations: 致胜棋子被撤走后棋盘上不再有连四，游戏理应回到进行中，winner 也不该继续挂着。
state 停留在 WON 会跟棋盘已经不满足连四条件互相矛盾。
棋盘并没有下满，撤销后应该是可以继续下棋的 IN_PROGRESS，不是 DRAW。
撤销的目标就是回滚已结束的游戏，article 明确把它设计成 Game 的正常操作。
optionExplanations_en: Once the winning disc is removed, no four-in-a-row remains, so the game should go back to in-progress with no winner attached.
Leaving state at WON would contradict a board that no longer shows a connect-four.
The board isn't full, so after undo the match is playable again — that's IN_PROGRESS, not a DRAW.
Undo exists specifically to roll back an ended game; the article treats it as a normal Game operation.

scenario: 外部代码手里同时拿得到 Game 实例和 game.getBoard() 返回的 Board 引用。
scenario_en: External code holds both the Game instance and the Board reference returned by game.getBoard().
q: 为什么外部代码不该直接调用 board.placeDisc()？
q_en: Why shouldn't external code call board.placeDisc() directly?
options: 棋盘变了，但 Game 的轮次和结果字段不会同步更新
Board 类没有公开 placeDisc 方法，编译就会失败
直接调用会导致 Board 的 rows/cols 字段被清零
这只是风格问题，功能上和走 game.makeMove() 完全等价
options_en: The board changes, but Game's turn and result fields never update in step.
Board doesn't expose placeDisc publicly, so it wouldn't even compile.
Calling it directly would zero out Board's rows/cols fields.
It's only a style preference — functionally identical to going through game.makeMove().
why: makeMove 是唯一编排完整流程的方法：落子、判胜负、切状态、换回合。绕过它直接改 Board，棋盘变了但 Game 的轮次和结果字段停在旧值。
why_en: makeMove is the only method that orchestrates the full flow — placement, win check, state update, turn switch. Bypassing it leaves Game's turn and result fields stale even though the board changed.
tradeoff: 只通过 game.makeMove() 修改棋局（单一入口）vs 外部代码直接调用 board.placeDisc()（绕过编排）
whenOtherWins: 如果确实需要脱离常规流程摆一颗棋子（比如加载存档重放历史局面），应该有专门的 replay/loadState 方法，而不是让普通调用方直接摸 Board。
optionExplanations: 落子发生在 Board，但只有 makeMove 会检查胜负、切换 currentPlayer、更新 state，绕过它就出现两者不同步。
placeDisc 是 Board 对外公开的方法，接口设计上并未禁止外部直接调用。
直接调用 placeDisc 只会写 grid 数组，不会碰 rows/cols 这两个固定字段。
结果完全不同：走 makeMove 会同步更新回合和结果，直接调用 Board 不会。
optionExplanations_en: The disc lands on the board, but only makeMove checks the win, switches currentPlayer, and updates state — skip it and the two objects fall out of sync.
placeDisc is a public method on Board; nothing in the interface blocks calling it from outside.
Calling placeDisc directly only writes into the grid array; it never touches the fixed rows/cols fields.
The outcomes differ completely — makeMove keeps turn and result in sync, a direct Board call does not.

scenario: Connect Four 支持撤销功能，Game 用一个 moveHistory 栈记录每次成功落子。
scenario_en: Connect Four supports undo, and Game keeps a moveHistory stack recording every successful move.
q: 补全 moveHistory 栈的最坏情况深度：
q_en: Fill in the worst-case depth of the moveHistory stack:
text: 棋盘是 {{6}} 行 × {{7}} 列 = {{42}} 格；一局最多有 42 次成功落子，所以 moveHistory 栈最坏情况要能装下 {{42}} 条 Move 记录。
why: rows×cols=6×7=42 是整局最多的落子次数（棋盘填满即触发 DRAW）；这个上限决定 moveHistory 栈和 undo 能回滚的最大步数。
why_en: rows times cols equals six times seven equals 42, the maximum discs a full game can place before it's a DRAW; that bound sets the worst-case size of the moveHistory stack and how far undo can ever roll back.

termDefinitions.meaning: moveHistory 是 Game 里的一个栈，记录每次成功落子的 player、row、col，用来支持撤销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: moveHistory is a stack on Game that records the player, row, and column of every successful move, to support undo.

scenario: isFull() 需要判断整个 7x6=42 格棋盘是不是已经下满。
scenario_en: isFull() must decide whether the entire 7x6 = 42-cell board is completely full.
q: isFull() 应该怎么判断，复杂度最低？
q_en: How should isFull() check this most cheaply?
options: 对 7 列各调用一次 canPlace(c)
遍历全部 42 个格子，逐格确认没有 null
只检查中间那一列（列 3）是否堆满就够了
维护一个已落子计数器，等于 42 时才判满
options_en: Call canPlace(c) once for each of the 7 columns.
Iterate all 42 cells one by one and confirm none is null.
Only check the middle column (column 3) — that's enough.
Maintain a placed-disc counter and declare full only when it equals 42.
why: canPlace(c) 只看顶行就能知道一列还有没有空位，isFull 遍历 7 列调用它，比逐格扫描 42 个格子更省。
why_en: canPlace(c) only checks the top cell to know if a column has room, so isFull looping over 7 columns beats scanning all 42 cells one by one.
tradeoff: 复用 canPlace 逐列判断（7 次顶行检查）vs 逐格扫描整个网格（42 次检查）
whenOtherWins: 如果已经在别处维护了准确的落子计数器，且每次 placeDisc/undo 都同步更新它，直接比较计数器也能做到 O(1)，但要多担一份状态同步的责任。
optionExplanations: canPlace 已经把这一列还有没有空位封装成 O(1) 的顶行检查，isFull 直接复用它最省事。
逐格扫描能得到正确答案，但比按列复用 canPlace 多做了几倍不必要的检查。
单看中间列会漏掉左右两侧还有空位的情况，得不出正确的整体结论。
计数器方案能work，但需要在每次 placeDisc 和 undo 时都手动同步，多一份状态要维护。
optionExplanations_en: canPlace already packages 'does this column have room' into an O(1) top-cell check, so isFull can just reuse it column by column.
A full cell-by-cell scan gets the right answer but does several times more checks than reusing canPlace per column.
Checking only the middle column misses the case where other columns still have room, giving a wrong overall answer.
A counter works, but it must be kept in sync by hand on every placeDisc and undo — one more piece of state to maintain.

scenario: 面试官确认：这版设计只需要支持一局游戏，不需要管理多局并发。
scenario_en: The interviewer confirms the design only needs to support one match at a time, not multiple concurrent games.
q: 这个范围决定跳过设计哪个组件？
q_en: What component does that scope let you skip designing?
options: 按 gameId 索引的 GameManager
Board 类本身，单局也不需要网格
GameState enum，单局不会出现平局
Player 类，单局只需要一个玩家
options_en: A GameManager indexed by gameId.
The Board class itself, even a single match skips the grid.
The GameState enum, a single match never ends in a draw.
The Player class, a single match only needs one player.
why: 只支持一局意味着不需要一个能按 gameId 查找、创建、销毁多个 Game 实例的管理层；这类多局路由组件在单局范围里完全不用画。
why_en: Supporting only one match means you don't need a layer that looks up, creates, and tears down many Game instances by gameId — that routing component is simply out of scope.
tradeoff: 单局无 GameManager（更简单）vs 多局并发需要 gameId 索引的仓储/管理层
whenOtherWins: 如果后续要支持多局并发，才需要引入 GameManager 按 gameId 管理多个 Game 实例，并给 Game 加上一个 id 字段。

termDefinitions.meaning: GameManager 是按 gameId 管理多个 Game 实例（创建/查找/销毁）的仓储层，只有支持多局并发时才需要。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GameManager is a repository layer that creates, looks up, and tears down multiple Game instances by id, needed only when concurrent games are in scope.

optionExplanations: 多局并发才需要按 gameId 查找/创建/销毁 Game 实例的管理层；单局范围内这层组件完全不用设计。
Board 是单局本身的核心网格，跟要不要支持多局无关，任何范围都需要它。
平局仍然是单局游戏本来就会出现的结果，跟并发范围毫无关系。
Connect Four 本来就是两人对战，Player 类数量从来跟单局/多局范围无关。
optionExplanations_en: Only multi-game concurrency needs a layer that looks up, creates, and tears down Game instances by id — that component is simply out of scope for one match.
Board is the core grid for the single match itself; it's needed regardless of concurrency scope.
A draw is a normal outcome even in a single match; it has nothing to do with concurrency scope.
Connect Four is inherently two players; the Player class count never depends on single- vs multi-game scope.

scenario: 面试官问：如果规则从连四改成变体连五，你的设计要改哪里？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: if the rule changed from four-in-a-row to a five-in-a-row variant, what would you change?
q: 方向向量方案和 WinChecker 类方案，哪个改动更小？
q_en: Which design needs a smaller change: direction vectors or per-direction WinChecker classes?
options: 方向向量方案只改 countInDirection 里的一个阈值常量
WinChecker 类方案只改一个类，因为逻辑本来就分散在各类里
两种方案改动量完全一样，都要碰四处代码
两种方案都做不到，必须重新设计 Board 的 grid 结构
options_en: The vector approach only needs one threshold constant changed inside countInDirection.
The WinChecker approach only needs one class changed, since the logic is already split up.
Both approaches need the exact same amount of change, touching four spots either way.
Neither approach can do it — Board's grid structure would need a full redesign.
why: 方向向量方案里连子判断只在 countInDirection 一处用 count>=4；改胜利长度只需把这个阈值改成 5。WinChecker 方案要在四个类里各改一次。
why_en: In the vector approach, the win threshold count>=4 lives in exactly one place inside countInDirection; changing win length means editing one constant. The WinChecker approach requires the same edit inside all four classes.
tradeoff: 方向向量（单点阈值常量）vs 四个 WinChecker 类（阈值分散在四处）
whenOtherWins: 如果不同方向未来真的需要不同的判定规则而不只是长度，把逻辑拆开成多个类反而更容易分别演化。
optionExplanations: 连子判断只写在一个共享的计数函数里，改判定长度就是改一个数字。
恰恰相反：WinChecker 方案里同样的计数逻辑复制了四份，改长度要同步改四处。
两种方案的改动量并不对称，方向向量方案的改动集中在一处而不是分散的四处。
胜利长度只影响判定阈值，跟 grid 本身怎么存储棋子完全无关，不需要动 grid 结构。
optionExplanations_en: The counting logic lives in one shared helper, so changing the win length is a one-number edit.
The opposite is true — the WinChecker approach duplicates the same counting logic four times, so the length has to change in all four places.
The two approaches aren't symmetric; the vector approach concentrates the change in one spot instead of four.
Win length only affects the threshold check, not how discs are stored in the grid, so the grid structure doesn't need to change.
